an4.48:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Visākho Pañcāliputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya aneḷagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya. Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen' upaṭṭhānasālā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
an4.48:2.1: Ko nu kho bhikkhave upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti . . . anissitāyāti? Āyasmā bhante Visākho Pañcāliputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samuttejesi sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya . . . anissitāyāti.
an4.48:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Visākhaṃ Pañcāliputtaṃ etad avoca :--Sādhu sādhu Visākha sādhu kho tvaṃ Visākha bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . anissitāyāti.
an4.48:4.1: Nābhāsamānaṃ jānanti missaṃ bālehi paṇḍitaṃ Bhāsamānañ ca jānanti desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ
an4.48:5.1: Bhāsaye jotaye dhammaṃ paggaṇhe isinaṃ dhajaṃ Subhāsitadhajā isayo dhammo hi isinan dhajo ti.
